title: LLM-guided iterative optimization yields a previously unreported Rb3BiI6 perovskite-inspired thin film
summary: A closed-loop materials workflow combined an LLM that distilled synthesis knowledge from papers, high-throughput hyperspectral imaging, and multi-objective Bayesian optimization with experimental feedback. In a demonstration, the team synthesized previously unreported Rb3BiI6 thin films and validated optimized films with optical bandgap analysis and X-ray diffraction. LLM-assisted initialization produced more Pareto-optimal samples and higher hypervolume than matched Latin-hypercube initialization in the reported paired campaign.
ai_technology: LLM-assisted synthesis-knowledge extraction and initialization with multi-objective Bayesian optimization and high-throughput hyperspectral imaging
organization: Massachusetts Institute of Technology; Toyota Research Institute; University of Tokyo

evidence.tested: A closed-loop materials workflow combined an LLM that distilled synthesis knowledge from papers, high-throughput hyperspectral imaging, and multi-objective Bayesian optimization with experimental feedback.
evidence.unknown: This is a preprint. The specific Rb3BiI6 result is reported as a previously unreported compound experimentally synthesized as thin films and checked by XRD and optical bandgap analysis; the study does not establish independent replication, long-term stability or device performance. Do not treat the accompanying optimization benchmark as an independent discovery.
evidence.ai_role: The LLM distilled literature synthesis expertise and initialized candidate experimental choices; Bayesian optimization iteratively selected subsequent conditions based on measured hyperspectral outcomes. Human operators synthesized thin films and performed optical/XRD validation.
